title: 第18章 报复二第19章 净火教一
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
半个小时后。
大巴车停靠在一处山道旁。
胡隆下了车，与他一起的还有几人，其中就包括了先前呕吐的那个年轻人。
“这位大哥，你也是去乌林村的吗？”
青年看着一旁的背着黑色背包的胡隆开口问道。
胡隆瞥了一眼面前这个年轻人。
只见他虽然身着一身干净衣物，但是肤色黝黑，一双露出袖口的粗糙手上，指关节处隆起厚厚的老茧。
他走起路来，上身微微前倾脚步落得很实，每一步都带着身体下沉的顿感，脚后跟先着地，这样走路的习惯是为了有利于身体平稳，应该是经常干苦力活的。
若是放在以前他根本观察不到这般细致。
但是自从下载了那个大师级的徒手格斗后，随着时间的推移。
胡隆发现自己对人体关节、发力点的理解越发深刻，已经深入本能。
因此，只是这一眼，便轻易得出了这个结论。
“嗯，我是来这旅游看看。”
“那挺巧，我家就在乌林村，我们一起吧。”
黝黑青年一副自来熟的模样。
指了指道路远处。
隐约可见到在远处路边的几根灰白色水泥电线杆，以及更远处飘荡的丝丝缕缕炊烟。
对于这个邀请。
胡隆想了想并没有选择拒绝。
刚好，他也想要仔细打探一下更加具体的情况。

随后，两个人顺着路边，向着远处走去。
在这个过程中，二人也互通了姓名。
黝黑青年名叫牛磊。
胡隆则是说自己叫‘王庭’。
在来之前，胡隆就查询过这乌林村的大致资料。
如今经过牛磊的口。
胡隆对乌林村的认知逐渐具体。
村里有二百多户，算是个大村了。
它背靠乌山，近期正借此优势被建设成景区。
同时又得益于邻近交通干线的地理位置，因而被选为新农村建设与乡村振兴的重点扶持对象。
而这牛磊也是在外面混的不行，听说家乡发展的不错，就准备回来搞个果园。
就在两人边走边聊之际。
很快，前面的乌林村也出现在眼前。
村口的大樟树下，老人们正提着水烟筒闲话家常。
content_en:
Half an hour later.
The bus stopped beside a mountain road.
Hu Long got out of the car, and there were several people with him, including the young man who had vomited earlier.
"Brother, are you going to Wulin Village too?"
The young man looked at Hu Long who was carrying a black backpack and asked.
Hu Long glanced at the young man in front of him.
Although he was wearing clean clothes, he had dark skin, rough hands with exposed cuffs, and thick calluses on his knuckles.
When he walked, his upper body leaned forward slightly and his steps were firm. Every step brought a feeling of body sinking, and heel struck the ground first. This walking habit was to help keep the body stable, and he should have been doing hard work frequently.
In the past, he would never have been able to observe it in such detail.
But since downloading that master-level hand-to-hand combat, as time goes by.
Hu Long found that his understanding of the joints and power points of the human body was getting deeper and deeper, and he had already penetrated into his instincts.
Therefore, just by looking at it, one could easily come to this conclusion.
"Well, I came here for a visit."
"That's a coincidence. My home is in Wulin Village. Let's go together."
The swarthy young man looked familiar.
Pointing to the distance on the road.
A few gray-white cement telephone poles on the roadside in the distance can be vaguely seen, as well as wisps of smoke floating in the distance.
for this invitation.
Hu Long thought for a moment and did not choose to refuse.
It just so happened that he also wanted to carefully inquire about the more specific situation.
Then, the two people walked along the road and into the distance.
In the process, the two also exchanged names.
The dark-skinned young man’s name is Niu Lei.
Hu Long said his name was ‘Wang Ting’.
Before coming, Hu Long inquired about the general information of Wulin Village.
Now it passed through Niu Lei's mouth.
Hu Long's understanding of Wulin Village gradually became more concrete.
There are more than 200 households in the village, which is considered a big village.
It is backed by Wushan Mountain and has recently been built into a scenic spot taking advantage of this advantage.
At the same time, thanks to its geographical location adjacent to major transportation lines, it was selected as a key support target for new rural construction and rural revitalization.
And this Niu Lei couldn't get along well outside. Hearing that his hometown was developing well, he planned to come back and start an orchard.
While the two were walking and chatting.
Soon, Wulin Village in front also appeared in front of us.
Under the big camphor tree at the entrance of the village, old people were holding hookahs and chatting.
